scope: Static structural mutation plan only. No checker/Engine/scorer/model execution, no new accuracy question/gold.
base: A structure copy of actual Google2-stage trace, with the explicit new-host completion_status field. Original v1 trace bytes must remain untouched.

static_cases.mutation: Remove answer_safety_state seq18, renumber seq19 to18; keep grounded pre-safety renderer and completed status.
static_cases.current_path: safety=[] is accepted unconditionally in answer_safety interval.
static_cases.required_result: Reject for pinned non-baseline verified profile with at least one unique grounded rendered target. Retain separate valid zero-target/noneligible/baseline profile controls.

static_cases.mutation: Keep answer_safety_state top-level round1 but change or delete observation.render_round, observation.observation.target, or phase; leave final terminal unchanged.
static_cases.current_path: Only safety event top-level round is inspected; nested data/target/schema/phase is ignored.
static_cases.required_result: Reject missing/malformed/wrong round/profile/target or duplicate/missing target observations when that profile actually runs safety for those grounded targets.

static_cases.mutation: Append copied final_render→renderer_candidate→answer_safety_state→answer_safety chain as round2 after a grounded_answer round1; reassign sequence/round. No retry resolution/grounding.
static_cases.current_path: Two noninterleaved rounds with proper stage names pass despite round1 not requiring verification.
static_cases.required_result: Reject round2 unless preceding authoritative stage requires_verification and a correctly bound finalization_retry_resolution changed-artifact transition occurred.

static_cases.mutation: Insert canonical_verified_target finalization plus matching-source render after already grounded renderer_candidate; render lacks required candidate/schema or contains a different phase/round-associated payload.
static_cases.current_path: Matching kind/round/source count only; previous-state guard and full render association not verified.
static_cases.required_result: Enforce host-declared optional-stage preconditions and complete matching-render schema; reject orphan/extra/mismatched rendering records. Do not reimplement Engine semantics.

static_cases.mutation: Legal host path: answer_safety status requires_verification; retry resolver produces the identical artifact; host records finalization_retry_resolution grounding and breaks without round2.
static_cases.current_path: last finalization is not last event, so events_after_final_safety_terminal rejects a legitimate completed withholding.
static_cases.required_result: Accept only the narrowly declared no-progress suffix when phase/round/outcome bind and artifact is unchanged; reject changed-artifact or arbitrary post-terminal event suffixes.
